brief_description: State-of-the-art image-to-video generation model with advanced prompt extension and audio support, capable of creating high-quality videos up to 1080P resolution from static images.
detailed_description: Wan2.5 I2V Preview is a comprehensive and open video foundation model that transforms static images into dynamic videos. This model supports advanced features including prompt extension, audio input, watermark control, and various resolution and duration options. It excels at animating static images with detailed motion, camera movements, and visual effects while maintaining the original image's composition and style.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text description of the motion and effects to apply to the input image (max 2000 characters). Describe camera movements, object animations, and visual effects.

parameters.name: img_url
parameters.description: Input image URL to animate. The model will use this image as the starting frame and generate motion based on the prompt.

parameters.name: audio_url
parameters.description: Audio file (wav/mp3, 3-30s, max 15MB) to sync with generated video

parameters.name: negative_prompt
parameters.description: Text describing what you don't want to see in the video (max 500 characters)

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Video resolution (affects pricing) specifies the resolution tier for the generated video. This setting adjusts the video's definition, which is measured in total pixels.

parameters.name: prompt_extend
parameters.description: Enable AI-powered prompt extension for better results

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: Add 'AI生成' watermark to the video

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Enable audio generation (only when audio_url is not provided)

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible results (0 for random)
